trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for REAL_ESTATE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- booking_amount: Handle token and booking amounts, allotment status and refund requests within RERA rules.
- site_visit_scheduling: Qualify a lead against real inventory and book a site visit with a named executive.

Business context:
- booking_amount: Indian developer and brokerage contact centre. Callers respond to listings, ask about availability, price and possession, and book site visits. Price and possession commitments are regulated claims.
- site_visit_scheduling: Indian developer and brokerage contact centre. Callers respond to listings, ask about availability, price and possession, and book site visits. Price and possession commitments are regulated claims.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [booking_amount]
  - Deduction truth: The deduction and refundable amount must be the ones the eligibility tool returns.
  - Eligibility first: No refund may be initiated before check_refund_eligibility has returned eligible.
  - No timeline promises: The processing time quoted must be the tool's, never an assurance of sooner.
  - Confirmed allotment: A confirmed allotment follows the agreement's cancellation terms, not the token policy.
  [site_visit_scheduling]
  - Price truth: Only a price returned by check_inventory may be quoted. No 'starting from' figure the tool did not return.
  - Possession claims: Possession may only be stated as the quarter the inventory record carries, never as a promise.
  - RERA disclosure: The RERA id must be stated when a project is discussed, when the tool returns one.
  - No investment advice: The agent must not advise whether a property is a good investment or predict appreciation.

Tools available to you (7): check_inventory, check_refund_eligibility, initiate_refund, lookup_booking, lookup_lead, schedule_site_visit, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: mr-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_inventory
model_visible_tools.description: List unsold units in a project with carpet area, floor, price and possession quarter.

model_visible_tools.name: check_refund_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the cancellation policy to a booking and return what is refundable.

model_visible_tools.name: initiate_refund
model_visible_tools.description: Start a refund against a cancelled booking.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_booking
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve a booking's unit, amounts paid, allotment state and cancellation window.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_lead
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve a lead's stated budget, preferred configuration and prior visits.

model_visible_tools.name: schedule_site_visit
model_visible_tools.description: Book a site visit slot with an assigned sales executive.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Misreads domain terminology and asks for it in plain words.
Needs each instruction confirmed before moving on.
Cannot follow an app-based instruction without a spoken alternative.
Repeats what the agent said to check they understood.

steps.purpose: State the reason for the outbound call.
steps.text: नमस्कार, मी developer office मधून बोलत आहे. हा call तुमच्या pending instalment बद्दल आहे.

steps.purpose: Express confusion and ask who is calling.
steps.text: कोणता instalment? मी तर पैसे भरले होते. आणि तुम्ही कोण बोलताय?

steps.purpose: Request identity verification factors.
steps.text: मी customer care मधून बोलतोय. पुढची माहिती देण्यापूर्वी, मला तुमची identity verify करायची आहे. तुमचं registered name आणि date of birth किंवा registered pincode सांगू शकता का?

steps.purpose: Provide name and pincode for verification.
steps.text: माझं नाव रमेश आहे आणि माझा पिनकोड ४११०४५ आहे.

steps.purpose: Provide name and pincode for verification with STT error.
steps.text: माझं नाव रमेश आहे आणि माझा पिनकोड ४११०४५ आहे.

steps.purpose: Verify the customer's identity.
Return the verification outcome.
Acknowledge successful verification and reiterate the pending instalment.
steps.text: धन्यवाद रमेश जी. तुमची identity verify झाली आहे. तुमच्या booking चा पुढचा instalment pending आहे.

steps.purpose: Request booking cancellation and ask about refund.
steps.text: मला पुढचे पैसे नाही भरायचे. मला हे booking cancel करायची आहे. Cancel म्हणजे पैसे परत भेटणार ना? किती भेटणार?

steps.purpose: Lookup the booking details.
Return the booking details.
State the amount paid and allotment status.
steps.text: तुमचे 300000 rupees amount paid आहे आणि तुमची allotment provisional आहे.

steps.purpose: Ask for clarification on the term provisional.
steps.text: Provisional म्हणजे काय? म्हणजे flat नक्की माझा झाला होता की नाही? आणि पैसे किती मिळतील?

steps.purpose: Explain provisional allotment and state intent to check refund eligibility.
steps.text: Provisional म्हणजे तुमची booking झाली होती पण final agreement झाला नव्हता. Refund amount साठी मी system मध्ये check करतो.

steps.purpose: Check refund eligibility.
Return refund eligibility and amounts.
State the deduction, refundable amount, and processing time.
steps.text: System प्रमाणे, 45000 deduction होईल आणि 255000 rupees refundable amount आहे. हे process व्हायला 14 processing days लागतील.

steps.purpose: Repeat the figures and request cash delivery at home.
steps.text: म्हणजे 45000 कापले जातील आणि 255000 मिळतील? आणि 14 processing days लागतील? मला cash मध्ये refund मिळेल का घरी येऊन? माझी तब्येत बरी नाहीये, मी बँकेत जाऊ शकत नाही.

steps.purpose: Decline the out-of-scope request for cash delivery.
steps.text: नाही, आम्ही cash मध्ये refund घरी देऊ शकत नाही. Refund तुमच्या registered bank account मध्येच transfer होतो. हे आमच्या policy च्या बाहेर आहे.

steps.purpose: Accept bank transfer but ask for a faster processing time.
steps.text: अच्छा, ठीक आहे. मग bank account मध्येच पाठवा. पण 14 दिवस खूप जास्त आहेत. नक्की 14 दिवसच लागतील ना? लवकरच करा, मला urgent आहेत.

steps.purpose: Refuse to guarantee a faster processing time and ask to initiate refund.
steps.text: Refund process व्हायला 14 processing days लागतात, हे tool नुसार आहे. मी त्यापेक्षा लवकर करण्याची assurance देऊ शकत नाही. मी refund initiate करू का?

steps.purpose: Confirm to initiate the refund.
steps.text: हो, cancel करा आणि refund initiate करा.

steps.purpose: Initiate the refund.
Return the refund initiation status.
Provide the refund ID and confirm the processing window.
steps.text: तुमचा refund initiate झाला आहे. तुमचा refund ID RF-8821 आहे. 255000 rupees 14 processing days मध्ये account मध्ये येतील.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge the refund ID.
steps.text: RF-8821. ठीक आहे, मी लिहून घेतला.

ir.terminal_condition: Refund initiated with an id, amount and processing window.
